skill_interface: market question and purpose in; axis comparison and integrity verdict out
source_policy: Use only the sealed Stage-derived comparison contract.
tool_policy: No market lookup, price advice, registry mutation, trade, or payment.
guardrail: Never treat markets, units, use acts, and claims as synonyms.
validation_rule: STOP outranks REVIEW and every concept has exactly one axis.
trace_policy: Record purpose, cutoff date, matched integrity rules, and missing status evidence.
approval_policy: Human approval is required for any external climate claim.
invocation_contract: One immutable comparison snapshot per run.
release_policy: Method changes require a new fingerprint and fixtures.
